outgoing.excerpt: Footprints of Dilophosaurus have been discovered in the Lavini di Marco area, near Rovereto ( Trentino, northern Italy).

outgoing.excerpt: Dilophosaurus was a theropod dinosaur from the Early Jurassic Period.
